summary: Add a two-consumer real-Store control for production journal pruning with a refused COMMIT.

replay.detail: Fixture-only fault; no startup replay, backfill or production mechanism.

schema.detail: No production SQL, DDL, index, trigger, migration or dependency change.

rules.detail: The unchanged Installer chooses the journal cutoff and deletes rows in the caller transaction; policy and all images remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: One authored, unrun control combines an owned changed witness, commit-hook marker and exact SQLite error, then full state conservation and a predetermined success arm. Fixed A32/B16 rejects a fast-only cutoff but does not distinguish slow-only selection. Prior tests and ceilings are unchanged; no savings, bound or adoption claim.

manual.detail: No configuration, activation or nextest change.

recovery.detail: A private Plain fixture removes its fault hook before return. No production hook API, retry, quarantine or cleanup policy. Two-consumer crash/reopen, image reclamation, accounting and lifetime/restore remain deferred.
